run_textual_inversion_training: run textual inversion training on images with a placeholder token and initializer token for stable diffusion
create_dataset_textual_inversion: create a TextualInversionDataset that loads images, applies transforms, and returns tokenized captions with a placeholder token
resize_token_embeddings: resize token embeddings in a FlaxCLIPTextModel to accommodate new placeholder tokens initialized from an initializer token
train_text_encoder_step: train the text encoder with gradient steps that only update the placeholder token embedding while freezing all other layers
save_trained_pipeline: save a trained FlaxStableDiffusionPipeline with learned token embeddings and upload to the Hugging Face Hub
